learning_outcomes.text: Examines the rules of working out plans, schemes and technical text documents.
Examines norms and instructions of Bulgarian and international standards considering drawing up technical documents.
Develops students' skills to cope with technical documents.

syllabus_topics: Different connections – threaded , splinted and permanent connections
Drawing of a machinery piece – content , composition , images , measures , tolerance of dimensions ,method of indicating surface texture , text information
Special documentation of some technical products
assessment_rules: The continuous assessment is formed from the marks of two tests and the score of the course assignment. An attestation is given when the course assignment is done and the lectures and practical classes are attended.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
